If you’ve seen my previous posts you know that right now our rescue is currently displaced and we are actively looking for a new place. Unfortunately this has been quite a challenge and it’s time we start helping animals again. On a smaller scale of course. I can’t just stop rescuing - it’s what I am meant to do. So when situations come up like this one, I know I have to do something. My plan is to build up our existing foster system so that we can help more animals, like Bruce. Bruce was going to be dumped outside (which would have been a death sentence) if we didn’t take him in tonight. Fortunately we have an amazing foster that is ready to take him tomorrow.
